## Health Score Rubric

Compute each category score (0-100), then apply the weights.

### Counting
- Deduplicate the same root cause across pages. Use one primary category, first applicable: Links, Accessibility, Functional, Performance, Visual, Content, UX, Console. No double deductions.

### Console (weight: 20%)
- 0 errors → 100
- 1-3 errors → 70
- 4-10 errors → 40
- 11+ errors → 10

### Links (weight: 15%)
- 0 broken → 100
- Each broken link → -15 (minimum 0)

### Per-Category Scoring (Visual, Functional, UX, Content, Performance, Accessibility)
Start at 100; deduct per finding:
- Critical issue → -25
- High issue → -15
- Medium issue → -8
- Low issue → -3
Floor: 0.

### Weights
| Category | Weight |
|----------|--------|
| Console | 15% |
| Links | 10% |
| Visual | 15% |
| Functional | 25% |
| UX | 20% |
| Performance | 15% |
| Content | 10% |
| Accessibility | 15% |

### Final Score
`score = Σ (category_score × weight)`

The final score is out of 100. A perfect site scores 100.
